gloss: to resemble; to be similar to

definitions.gloss: to resemble; to be similar to; to be analogous to
definitions.explanation: To share common characteristics or features with something else, making the two seem alike.

examples.japanese: この{二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}は{類似|るいじ}している。
{類似|るいじ}した{商品|しょうひん}が{多|おお}く{出回|でまわ}っている。
examples.english: Many similar products are on the market.

examples.japanese: この{症状|しょうじょう}はインフルエンザに{類似|るいじ}しているが、{原因|げんいん}は{異|こと}なる。
examples.english: These symptoms resemble influenza, but the cause is different.

notes:
{類似|るいじ}する is a formal, analytical word for similarity. It is commonly used in legal, academic, and business contexts — for example, when comparing products, cases, or phenomena. The participial form {類似|るいじ}した (similar) is very frequent.

USAGE:
- ～に{類似|るいじ}する: to be similar to ~
- ～と{類似|るいじ}する: to be similar to ~ (interchangeable with に)
- {類似|るいじ}した + noun: similar + noun

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {類似|るいじ}{品|ひん}: imitation product; knockoff
- {類似|るいじ}{点|てん}: point of similarity
- {類似|るいじ}{性|せい}: similarity; resemblance
- {類似|るいじ}{商標|しょうひょう}: similar trademark
- {類似|るいじ}{表現|ひょうげん}: similar expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {似|に}ている: to be similar; to look alike — everyday, conversational word for resemblance
- {共通|きょうつう}する: to have in common — focuses on shared elements rather than overall resemblance
- {酷似|こくじ}する: to closely resemble — stronger, implies near-identical similarity
